sourceDetail: Cabin geometry (number, deck, centroid x/y) parsed from deckmaps.com versioned deck SVGs (/data/out/princess/coral-princess/v7/deck-<N>.<hash>.svg), one <path class="cabin-shape" data-cabin> per stateroom (re-verified 2026-07-27: all 7 deck SVGs fetched HTTP 200 from the live source and are byte-identical to the parsed copies). UNLIKE Royal Caribbean, Princess deckmaps SVGs do NOT encode stateroom category: every cabin path is fill="#fff" with a black stroke over monochrome line-art, so category cannot be read from colour. Category was instead derived by spatially registering each deckmaps cabin centroid against the category-coded HTML image-map regions (<area title="Category XX ...">) on cruisedeckplans.com per-deck Coral Princess pages, using a per-deck bbox/affine registration anchored on cruisedeckplans' listed accessible cabins (known number+category), then nearest-region assignment for cabins outside any region polygon. Category-code legend (IA-IF Inside; OB/OC/OD/OE/OV/OW/OY/OZ/O5/O6 Oceanview; BA-BF/B1/B2/BY/BZ Balcony; MB/MD/ME/MY/M1 Mini-Suite; S5/S6 Suite) taken from cruisedeckplans category tooltips and collapsed to Princess marketing groupings.

notes.completeness: FULL geometry grid: all 1000 staterooms across the 7 guest decks with cabins (5 Plaza, 6 Fiesta, 8 Emerald, 9 Dolphin, 10 Caribe, 11 Baja, 12 Aloha). Per-deck counts (P=75, F=13, E=160, D=173, C=192, B=226, A=161) come straight from the deckmaps SVGs; no cabin number was invented. Total 1000 is marginally above Coral Princess's commonly-published ~987-stateroom capacity (deckmaps draws a handful of extra/again-listed shapes, e.g. paired accessible or connecting shells); treat 987 as the marketing figure and 1000 as the drawn-shape count.
notes.category: APPROXIMATE / DERIVED, not from the geometry source. Princess deckmaps SVGs carry no category colour (all fills #fff), so categories were assigned by spatially matching each cabin to cruisedeckplans.com's category-coded deck-plan regions. Validation: 20/20 (100%) of cruisedeckplans' listed accessible-cabin anchors were reproduced into the correct marketing group. Accuracy is highest inside contiguous category blocks and lowest at category boundaries and on decks 6/9/12 where cruisedeckplans supplied no accessible anchors (registration falls back to the deck bbox + nearest-region). Marketing groupings collapse the finer Princess sub-codes (IA-IF=Interior; OB/OC/OD/OE/OV/OW/OY/OZ/O5/O6=Oceanview incl. Deluxe Oceanview; BA-BF/B1/B2/BY/BZ=Balcony; MB/MD/ME/MY/M1=Mini-Suite; S5/S6=Suite). Aggregate split lands in the expected range but the Mini-Suite/Balcony boundary is the least certain (some balcony cabins near mini-suite blocks may be over-assigned to Mini-Suite, and the full-Suite count is low because only S5/S6 regions were mapped). Treat individual-cabin category as a strong estimate, not a booking-grade guarantee.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic. Bow direction confirmed forward = top of each deck SVG (lowest cabin numbers cluster at lowest y, consistently across all 7 decks). section = forward/mid/aft thirds of each deck's occupied length. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED. side follows the Princess hull convention even cabin number = port, odd = starboard. This was cross-checked against the SVG geometry (centre-x split, low x = port): parity and geometry agree on ~99% of cabins where the deck spans both sides (100% on decks 5/8/9/11/12, 93% on deck 10; deck 6 is a small 13-cabin forward block that does not span the beam so its geometric split is unreliable and parity is used). If deckmaps drew any deck mirrored the geometric check would still pass via parity; validate against a known cabin before relying on it.
notes.obstructed: deckmaps/cruisedeckplans geometry carries no obstructed-view flag here; obstructed=false for all (source does not encode obstruction; NOT asserted as guaranteed clear-view).

colorLegend.#fff: No category encoding. Princess deckmaps deck SVGs render every cabin shape as white fill (#fff) with a black stroke over monochrome line-art; category is NOT conveyed by colour (contrast Royal Caribbean). Category in this file was derived externally from cruisedeckplans.com - see sourceDetail/notes.
